title: FixTooManyRegisteredChannels
description: A Minecraft mod to fix "Too Many Registered Channels" error
body:
# FixTooManyRegisteredChannels A client-only mod
Fix `Too Many Registered Channels` error when connecting to a server.
After enabled, this mod will block any channel registering except `minecraft:` when playing multiplayer
Require Mod Menu & YACL
Needs to open configureation interface in Mod Menu and enable it, it's disabled by default 一个客户端 Mod
修复连接至服务器时遇到的 `Too Many Registered Channels` 错误
开启后，在游玩多人游戏时这个 Mod 将会阻止除了 `minecraft:` 外的任何频道注册
需要 Mod Menu 与 YACL
需要在 Mod Menu 中打开配置介面并启动开关，默认不启用
